class.name: MaszynaMoverRailVehicleBrake
class.description: [RailVehicleBrake] simulated by the vendored Mover ([code]TMoverParameters[/code]): its configuration is written into the vehicle's Mover and its live values are read straight from it. Created by the FIZ import for a vehicle [MaszynaMoverVehicleServer] simulates; everything else reaches it through [RailVehicleBrake].

method.name: get_delay_setting
method.description: The delay setting in use, a [enum BrakeDelaySetting] ([code]BrakeDelayFlag[/code]).

method.name: get_edb_cylinder_pressure
method.description: The cylinders' pressure the electrodynamic brake works against [lb]MPa[rb] ([code]Hamulec->GetEDBCP()[/code]).

method.name: get_emergency_valve_flow
method.description: The flow out of the emergency valve ([code]EmergencyValveFlow[/code]) - what its hiss follows.

method.name: get_handle_braking_flow
method.description: The flow of the driver's brake valve while it brakes, for its hiss ([code]Handle->GetSound()[/code], [code]hamulce.h:77-81[/code]).

method.name: get_handle_control_chamber_flow
method.description: The control chamber's wave outflow of the driver's brake valve, for its hiss.

method.name: get_handle_emergency_flow
method.description: The flow of the driver's brake valve in emergency, for its hiss.

method.name: get_handle_release_flow
method.description: The flow of the driver's brake valve while it releases, for its hiss.

method.name: get_handle_timing_reservoir_flow
method.description: The timing reservoir's outflow of the driver's brake valve, for its hiss.

method.name: get_local_aeim_position
method.description: The independent brake's EP position an asynchronous EMU sets ([code]LocalBrakePosAEIM[/code]).

method.name: get_main_valve_flow
method.description: The flow through the driver's brake valve into or out of the pipe ([code]dpMainValve[/code]).

method.name: get_operation_mode
method.description: The operation mode the brake is set to, one bit of [member cntrl_brake_op_modes] ([code]BrakeOpModeFlag[/code]).

members.member: Air leak speed multiplier for brakes.
Friction material used by the brake blocks or discs.
[code]BPT[/code] The brake pressure table, right after the [code]Cntrl.[/code] section in the FIZ file. Each item maps a brake handle position to the resulting pipe/cylinder pressures and brake type.
[code]Cntrl.BrakeHandle[/code] Type of the main (train) brake handle.
[code]Cntrl.LocBrakeHandle[/code] Type of the local (independent) brake handle.
[code]Brake:EVArea[/code] Outlet cross-section of the main tank safety valve, in l/m.

[code]CompressorList[/code] Compressor programmer table (not documented on the FIZ wiki). Each item is one programmer position controlling whether the compressor is allowed to run and multipliers for its speed and cut-in/cut-out pressure thresholds.

Behavior upon overpressure in the main tank when the compressor is driven by an internal combustion engine: false - the compressor pumps to the atmosphere, the tank slowly empties itself, after reaching [member compressor_cab_a_min_pressure], the compressor pumps to the tank true - the compressor fully fills the tank, the valve releases pressure from the tank upon reaching [member compressor_cab_a_max_pressure]
Return spring force per cylinder in kN.
Size index of the ESt family camshaft valve (e.g., 1–3). Used only with ESt/LSt-type valves.
Minimum brake handle position in order to unblock the main pipe
Slack adjuster resistance force in kN.
High-to-low pressure ratio of braking in Rapid mode (dimensionless multiplier).

[code]Brake:BrakeValve[/code] as the data writes it ([code]BrakeValveParams[/code]). An ESt3 distributor's relays are read off it: [code]PZZ[/code] passes the independent brake's pressure to the cylinders, [code]AL2[/code], [code]-s216[/code] and [code]-ED[/code] choose others.

constants.constant: Cast-iron tread brake blocks P10 (variant Bgu). Legacy phosphorus cast‑iron shoes used on block brakes; robust but noisy and abrasive. Use for older stock with P10 blocks.
Cast-iron tread brake blocks P10 (variant Bg). Similar to Bgu with a slightly different friction curve; traditional iron shoes for block brakes.
Disc brake, pad type D1. Standard railway disc brake friction law; select when the vehicle is equipped with disc brakes.
Disc brake, pad type D2. Alternative compound/geometry with a different μ(v) characteristic (typically higher friction at speed) for disc brakes.
Composite tread brake blocks Frenoplast FR‑513 (K‑block). Quieter and less wheel‑abrasive than cast iron; common on modernized wagons.
Composite tread brake blocks (e.g., Cosid K‑block family). Use as a generic composite block when a more specific type is unknown.
Cast-iron tread brake blocks P10 (variant yBg). P10 iron shoes with a modified characteristic ("y" curve) used in some braking tables.
Cast-iron tread brake blocks P10 (variant yBgu). As above with the "y" curve applied to the Bgu variant.
Disc brake (D1 pads) plus magnetic track brake. Use when the vehicle has magnetic rail brakes; pneumatic braking follows D1 while magnetic force adds at higher speeds.
FD1 handle (typically used as the local/independent brake handle).
Westinghouse W with LU (load-compensating) module, variant VI.
Westinghouse W with LU (load-compensating) module, variant L.
Westinghouse W with LU (load-compensating) module, variant XR.
Knorr KP distributor valve (passenger variant with quick service).
Knorr Kss distributor valve (freight, two-step characteristics).
Knorr KKg distributor valve (combined passenger/freight characteristics).
Knorr KE distributor valve (widely used on passenger stock).
SW-series distributor valve (e.g. Oerlikon / SAB WABCO family).
